name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q01 - Enthalpy of atomisation and bonding in zinc

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In the 3d transition series, zinc has the lowest enthalpy of atomisation (\(126\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\)).

Statement II: In zinc, the 3d subshell is completely filled (\(3d^{10}\)), so no electrons from 3d orbitals participate in interatomic metallic bonding.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: 3d संक्रमण श्रेणी में, जिंक की कणन एन्थैल्पी सबसे कम (\(126\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\)) होती है।

कथन II: जिंक में, 3d उपकोश पूर्णतः भरा (\(3d^{10}\)) होता है, अतः अंतरापरमाणुक धात्विक आबंधन में 3d कक्षकों का कोई भी इलेक्ट्रॉन भाग नहीं लेता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle of Atomisation Enthalpy
The enthalpy of atomisation of a transition metal depends directly on the strength of interatomic metallic bonding, which is governed by the number of unpaired and available valence electrons participating in bonding.

Step 2: Evaluation of the First Statement
Across the first transition series (\(\mathrm{Sc}\) to \(\mathrm{Zn}\)), zinc exhibits the lowest enthalpy of atomisation with an experimental value of \(126\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\). Hence, the first statement is correct.

Step 3: Evaluation of the Second Statement
Zinc has the ground-state valence configuration \(3d^{10} 4s^2\). Because the \(3d\) subshell is fully filled, its \(d\) electrons are held firmly and do not participate in metallic bonding; only the two \(4s\) electrons are involved. Hence, the second statement is correct.

Step 4: Final Conceptual Answer
Both statements are correct.

चरण 1: कणन एन्थैल्पी का सिद्धांत
किसी संक्रमण धातु की कणन एन्थैल्पी अंतरापरमाणुक धात्विक आबंधन की प्रबलता पर निर्भर करती है, जो आबंधन में भाग लेने वाले संयोजी इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या द्वारा निर्धारित होती है।

चरण 2: प्रथम कथन का मूल्यांकन
प्रथम संक्रमण श्रेणी (\(\mathrm{Sc}\) से \(\mathrm{Zn}\)) में, जिंक की कणन एन्थैल्पी सबसे कम होती है जिसका प्रायोगिक मान \(126\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\) है। अतः प्रथम कथन सही है।

चरण 3: द्वितीय कथन का मूल्यांकन
जिंक का संयोजी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास \(3d^{10} 4s^2\) होता है। पूर्णतः भरा होने के कारण \(3d\) इलेक्ट्रॉन धात्विक आबंधन में भाग नहीं लेते; केवल दो \(4s\) इलेक्ट्रॉन भाग लेते हैं। अतः द्वितीय कथन सही है।

चरण 4: अंतिम वैचारिक उत्तर
दोनों कथन सही हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q02 - Ground state configuration of scandium and transition status of zinc

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: A scandium atom possesses a completely filled 3d subshell in its neutral ground state.

Statement II: Zinc is classified as a typical transition element according to the IUPAC definition.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: एक स्कैंडियम परमाणु अपनी उदासीन मूल अवस्था में पूर्णतः भरा हुआ 3d उपकोश रखता है।

कथन II: जिंक को IUPAC परिभाषा के अनुसार एक प्रारूपिक संक्रमण तत्व के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
Scandium has atomic number \(Z = 21\). Its neutral ground-state electronic configuration is \([\mathrm{Ar}] 3d^1 4s^2\). The \(3d\) subshell contains only a single electron and is incompletely filled. Describing it as completely filled is false. Hence, the first statement is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
According to IUPAC, transition metals are defined as elements having incompletely filled \(d\) orbitals either in their neutral ground state or in common oxidation states. Zinc (\(Z = 30\)) has a \(3d^{10}\) configuration in both neutral \(\mathrm{Zn}\) and its common \(\mathrm{Zn}^{2+}\) state, and therefore is not regarded as a transition element. Hence, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
Both statements are incorrect.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q03 - Melting points of transition metals and anomaly of manganese

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: The high melting points of transition metals are attributed to the involvement of greater numbers of electrons from (n-1)d in addition to ns electrons in metallic bonding.

Statement II: Manganese exhibits the highest melting point among the elements of the 3d transition series.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: संक्रमण धातुओं के उच्च गलनांक धात्विक आबंधन में ns इलेक्ट्रॉनों के अतिरिक्त (n-1)d कक्षकों के अधिक इलेक्ट्रॉनों के भाग लेने के कारण होते हैं।

कथन II: मैंगनीज 3d संक्रमण श्रेणी के तत्वों में सबसे उच्च गलनांक प्रदर्शित करता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
Transition metals display high melting points because delocalised metallic bonding incorporates both outer \(ns\) and penultimate \((n-1)d\) electrons, resulting in exceptionally strong interatomic forces. Hence, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
In the \(3d\) series, melting points rise to a peak at chromium (\(d^5\)). Manganese displays an anomalous dip in melting point due to a particularly stable half-filled configuration in a complex, less cohesive crystal structure. Thus, manganese does not have the highest melting point in the series. Hence, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
The first statement is correct, but the second statement is incorrect.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q04 - Atomic radii of zirconium and hafnium under lanthanoid contraction

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: The atomic radius of hafnium is significantly larger than that of zirconium because hafnium contains an additional principal energy level.

Statement II: The filling of 4f orbitals before the 5d transition series results in the lanthanoid contraction.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: हाफ्नियम की परमाणु त्रिज्या ज़िरकोनियम की तुलना में काफी बड़ी होती है क्योंकि हाफ्नियम में एक अतिरिक्त मुख्य ऊर्जा स्तर होता है।

कथन II: 5d संक्रमण श्रेणी से पहले 4f कक्षकों का भरा जाना लैन्थेनॉइड आकुंचन का कारण बनता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
Although hafnium (period 6) has one more principal shell than zirconium (period 5), their atomic radii are virtually identical (\(\mathrm{Zr} = 160\text{ pm}\), \(\mathrm{Hf} = 159\text{ pm}\)). Thus, hafnium is not significantly larger than zirconium. Hence, the first statement is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
Before the \(5d\) elements, the fourteen \(4f\) orbitals are filled. The poor shielding of \(4f\) electrons causes a steady increase in effective nuclear charge, pulling the electrons inward. This phenomenon is termed the lanthanoid contraction and offsets the expected downward expansion in size. Hence, the second statement is correct.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
The first statement is incorrect, but the second statement is correct.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q05 - Characteristics and formation of interstitial compounds

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: Interstitial compounds retain metallic electrical conductivity and possess melting points higher than those of the pure parent metals.

Statement II: Interstitial compounds are formed when small non-metal atoms like hydrogen, carbon, or nitrogen are trapped inside the crystal lattices of transition metals.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: अंतराकाशी यौगिक धात्विक विद्युत चालकता बनाए रखते हैं और शुद्ध मूल धातुओं की तुलना में उच्च गलनांक रखते हैं।

कथन II: अंतराकाशी यौगिक तब बनते हैं जब हाइड्रोजन, कार्बन या नाइट्रोजन जैसे छोटे अधातु परमाणु संक्रमण धातुओं के क्रिस्टल जालकों में समा जाते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
According to the characteristic properties of interstitial compounds (such as \(\mathrm{TiC, Fe_3H, Mn_4N}\)), they retain high metallic electrical conductivity because free valence electrons remain delocalised, and they have higher melting points and extreme hardness due to enhanced lattice bonding. Hence, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
Interstitial compounds are defined as non-stoichiometric solids formed when small atoms like \(\mathrm{H, C,}\) or \(\mathrm{N}\) fit into the vacant interstitial sites within the transition metal crystal lattice. Hence, the second statement is correct.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
Both statements are correct.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q06 - Magnetic properties of manganate and permanganate ions

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: The green manganate ion (\(\mathrm{MnO}_4^{2-}\)) is diamagnetic in nature due to the complete absence of unpaired electrons.

Statement II: The purple permanganate ion (\(\mathrm{MnO}_4^-\)) is strongly paramagnetic because manganese possesses one unpaired d electron.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: हरा मैंगनेट आयन (\(\mathrm{MnO}_4^{2-}\)) अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों की पूर्ण अनुपस्थिति के कारण प्रतिचुंबकीय प्रकृति का होता है।

कथन II: बैंगनी परमैंगनेट आयन (\(\mathrm{MnO}_4^-\)) प्रबल अनुचुंबकीय होता है क्योंकि मैंगनीज में एक अयुग्मित d इलेक्ट्रॉन उपस्थित होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
In the green manganate ion, \(\mathrm{MnO}_4^{2-}\), manganese is in the \(+6\) oxidation state with configuration \(3d^1\). Because it has one unpaired electron, \(\mathrm{MnO}_4^{2-}\) is paramagnetic, not diamagnetic. Hence, the first statement is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
In the purple permanganate ion, \(\mathrm{MnO}_4^-\), manganese is in the \(+7\) oxidation state with configuration \(3d^0\). Having zero unpaired electrons, \(\mathrm{MnO}_4^-\) is diamagnetic at room temperature (exhibiting only weak temperature-dependent paramagnetism). Hence, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
Both statements are incorrect.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q07 - Redox tendencies of chromous and manganic ions and electrode potentials

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In aqueous solution, divalent chromium (\(\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}\)) acts as a strong reducing agent while trivalent manganese (\(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}\)) acts as a strong oxidising agent.

Statement II: The standard electrode potential for the \(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}/\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}\) redox couple is highly negative because the divalent manganese cation is unstable.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: जलीय विलयन में, द्विसंयोजी क्रोमियम (\(\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}\)) एक प्रबल अपचायक के रूप में कार्य करता है जबकि त्रिसंयोजी मैंगनीज (\(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}\)) एक प्रबल ऑक्सीकारक के रूप में कार्य करता है।

कथन II: \(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}/\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}\) रेडॉक्स युग्म का मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव अत्यधिक ऋणात्मक होता है क्योंकि द्विसंयोजी मैंगनीज धनायन अस्थायी होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
Both \(\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}\) and \(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}\) have a \(d^4\) electronic configuration. However, \(\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}\) is readily oxidised to \(\mathrm{Cr}^{3+}\) to attain the stable half-filled \(t_{2g}^3\) sub-level (\(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Cr}^{3+}/\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}} = -0.41\text{ V}\)), making it strongly reducing. Conversely, \(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}\) is easily reduced to \(\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}\) to attain the stable half-filled \(d^5\) configuration (\(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}/\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}} = +1.57\text{ V}\)), making it strongly oxidising. Hence, the first statement is correct.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
The standard reduction potential for \(\mathrm{Mn}^{3+}/\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}\) is strongly positive (\(+1.57\text{ V}\)), not negative. This large positive value reflects the exceptional thermodynamic stability of the half-filled \(d^5\) configuration of the \(\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}\) ion. Hence, the second statement is incorrect.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
The first statement is correct, but the second statement is incorrect.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CLASS12_CHAPTER08_STATEMENT_Q08 - Stoichiometry of dichromate reduction and oxidation of ferrous ions

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In acidic solution, one mole of dichromate ions completely oxidises exactly one mole of ferrous ions.

Statement II: In acidic medium, the reduction half-reaction of one mole of dichromate ions consumes 14 moles of hydrogen ions and accepts 6 moles of electrons.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: अम्लीय विलयन में, डाइक्रोमेट आयनों का एक मोल ठीक एक मोल फेरस आयनों को पूर्णतः ऑक्सीकृत करता है।

कथन II: अम्लीय माध्यम में, डाइक्रोमेट आयनों के एक मोल की अपचयन अर्ध-अभिक्रिया में 14 मोल हाइड्रोजन आयन प्रयुक्त होते हैं तथा 6 मोल इलेक्ट्रॉन ग्रहण किए जाते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
In acidic medium, the reduction of dichromate is: \[\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-} + 14\mathrm{H}^+ + 6\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Cr}^{3+} + 7\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}\] Each ferrous ion donates 1 electron: \[\mathrm{Fe}^{2+} \rightarrow \mathrm{Fe}^{3+} + \mathrm{e}^-\] Equating electron transfer requires 6 moles of \(\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}\) per mole of \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\). Stating that only one mole of ferrous ions is oxidised is incorrect. Hence, the first statement is incorrect.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
The balanced reduction half-reaction shows that 1 mole of \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\) combines with 14 moles of \(\mathrm{H}^+\) and accepts 6 moles of electrons to form 2 moles of \(\mathrm{Cr}^{3+}\) and 7 moles of \(\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}\). Hence, the second statement is correct.

Step 3: Final Conceptual Answer
The first statement is incorrect, but the second statement is correct.

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.
